title: Summary: -vá/-vé in Contrast with Other Cases

sections.content:
Remember the key contrasts:
- **-vá / -vé** = change of state, transformation (*Orvossá vált.* = He became a doctor.)
- **nominative** = static identity (*Orvos.* = He is a doctor.)
- **-nak / -nek** = destination or purpose (*Tanul orvosnak.* = He is studying to be a doctor.)

items.spanish: Péter orvosként dolgozik, miután kiváló orvossá vált.
items.english: Péter works as a doctor after he became an excellent doctor.
